title: Pisces, the Stars Warn of Chaos
script_text: Stop! Pisces, the stars are slamming a volatile square at you, stirring your Water element emotions. Mercury is squaring Neptune in your twelfth house, fogging intuition with overthinking. Jupiter sextiles Mars in the fourth house, pushing bold home actions. During this window, your subconscious receives vivid dreams that hold keys to hidden opportunities, so keep a journal by your bedside. The Mercury square sparks miscommunication, so pause before speaking; single Pisces attract a mysterious artist drawn to your emotional depth and may spark a sudden, passionate flirtation. Saturn conjoins Venus in the tenth house, urging you to swap flattery for solid work, and a surprise bonus crowns your recent perseverance while a hidden mentor offers guidance. Avoid rash decisions under the Mercury square; trust Neptune’s calm or enjoy a fleeting moment of inspiration. Follow for tomorrow’s reading to stay ahead of the cosmic shifts.
